justification.dataset: 000044 Achilles linear-maze CA1 is the canonical dataset for theta phase precession, an expert-standard choice.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3 with correct unit/epoch alignment and a genuine 1000x position-rate corruption bug correctly diagnosed and fixed, though the maze epoch is hardcoded and end-field artifacts were left unresolved.
justification.analysis: The run ended before any theta or phase-precession analysis was performed, so it never tested the phenomenon it was asked about.
justification.correctness: No phenomenon result or numbers were produced at all; only prerequisite place-field spatial-info values exist, and the fields are dominated by track-end artifacts.
justification.figures: No figure shows theta phase precession; the only figures are diagnostic place-field tuning curves peaking at the track ends, not the requested phenomenon.
justification.honesty: There is no write-up and no claimed result, so nothing is overstated and the final status honestly reports the run stalled on a background computation.
